description.en: Original small branching fused-sand glass tube with a continuous outer shell and connected true hollow core opening at the base and all tips. Irregular fused wall, unequal branch hierarchy and restrained opaque glass-lined lumen; not a smooth plastic pipe, plant root, copied specimen or complex transparent material. Empty eras/biomes remain unspecified.
